title: Growlithe Can Remember Your Scent—and Detect Emotions
premise: Growlithe can remember scents forever and use smell to detect emotions in other living things.
audiencePromise: Follow one scent from a territory warning to Growlithe's strange ability to detect emotions.
openLoop: How does one scent become both a warning and an emotion clue?
payoff: One smell can start a defense now, then stay remembered later.
engagementQuestion: Would you trust Growlithe, or keep your feelings private?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and curious. Speak clearly with short pauses before each reveal. Stress scent, emotions, and remember. Keep the final question playful and open.

scenes.headline: IT SMELLS YOUR EMOTIONS
scenes.narration: Growlithe can detect emotions—and never forget your scent.
scenes.caption: A SCENT CAN REVEAL MORE

scenes.headline: UNKNOWN SMELL. LOUD RESPONSE.
scenes.narration: An unknown smell makes Growlithe roar, forcing the intruder out.
scenes.caption: SMELL DETECTED. TERRITORY DEFENDED.

scenes.headline: SMELL DETECTS EMOTIONS
scenes.narration: Then smell does something stranger: it detects other living things' emotions.
scenes.caption: SMELL DETECTS EMOTIONS

scenes.headline: THE SCENT NEVER LEAVES
scenes.narration: Once Growlithe smells something, it will not forget that scent.
scenes.caption: NO SCENT FORGOTTEN

scenes.headline: ONE SMELL. TWO CONSEQUENCES.
scenes.narration: One smell can start a defense now, then stay remembered later.
scenes.caption: DEFENSE NOW. MEMORY LATER.

scenes.headline: TRUST THE NOSE?
scenes.narration: Would you trust Growlithe, or keep your feelings private?
scenes.caption: TRUST ITS NOSE OR HIDE YOUR FEELINGS?
